name: Case law: United States, the New York Court of Appeals
label: United States case law (the New York Court of Appeals)
coverage: 111440 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 110403 with their opinion text and 1037 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 115 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: each decision is added by one Kind: court commit; a Kind: correction commit (Corrects: the commit it corrects, Corrected: the day) later fixes a file's text or details, dated with the same In-force day, and is credited only with the lines it changed. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from New York Reports (N.Y., N.Y.2d; published under contract) and, after N.Y.2d, the North Eastern Reporter (West). The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
source.reporters: New York Reports (N.Y., N.Y.2d; published under contract) and, after N.Y.2d, the North Eastern Reporter (West)

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, a range ("§§ 101-1330", "§§ 1 through 16") links neither end (its ends are no more cited than the sections between them); a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)

appended.reporters: N.Y., N.Y. 2d, N.Y.3d, N.Y. St. Rep., N.E.3d, N.Y. Crim., How. Pr., Silv. Ct. App., Trans. App., Abb. Ct. App., Keyes, Lock. Rev. Cas. and 19 more

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day; a docket, name or citation in common; and the same text), such as another reporter's copy of it; both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
